title: Accessibility test findings for one page
description: Output of one test run on one page, in the finding format of testing-kit/README.md. One file per page.

page.description: URL of the tested page, exactly as given to the tester.

models.description: For AI: model id per role, for example {"orchestrator": "...", "keyboard": "..."}.

groups.description: Per group id: whether the group was run, found inapplicable, or skipped, with a short note.

criterion.description: WCAG success criterion id, for example 2.4.7.

group.description: Group id that produced the finding, or pre-step.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element, if the finding concerns one.

evidence.description: Short description of what was observed; reference collected artifacts by file name.
